source:
## Comments: a line of text with an optional trailing '#' comment. The
## text part is printable runs without '#'; the comment runs to end of
## line. Demonstrates exclusion classes and optionality.
grammar Comments version "1.0.0" edition "v1" {
  ws = %x20 / %x09
  pq = *ws
  nl = %x0A
  ## any non-newline byte: the comment's body.
  nonl = %x01-09 / %x0B-10FFFF
  comment = "#" *nonl
  ## printable, no space, no '#': text atoms.
  text_char = %x21-22 / %x24-7E
  text = 1*text_char *( 1*ws 1*text_char )
  line = text pq [comment]

  entry main: line

  test {
    accept "hello world"
    accept "x = 1 # trailing note"
    accept "a#not-a-comment-boundary"
    reject ""
    reject "# comment-only is not text"
  }
}
